mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate signals weakening consumer demand and rising recession risk, which increases discount rates and depresses S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals deteriorating demand, which reduces earnings growth and increases discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of falling consumption (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate signals a tightening cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising rates (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals robust labor market growth, which supports earnings and reduces recession risk, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of rising payrolls (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) signals improving economic activity and higher earnings potential, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of rising industrial production (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the housing starts index (HOUST) signals weakening residential investment and consumer confidence, which reduces earnings growth and increases discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of falling housing starts (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) signals rising inflation, which prompts the Fed to raise rates and increases discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising inflation (t-test p > 0.05).
